sections.title: Welcome to Trigonometric Ratios!
learning_goals: Get ready to explore the fundamental concepts of trigonometry.

sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Define the six trigonometric ratios for a right-angled triangle.
Calculate all trigonometric ratios given one ratio.
Prove angle equality using trigonometric ratios.
Verify trigonometric identities.
Understand and apply reciprocal trigonometric identities.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Overview of learning objectives, avatar with bullet points.

sections.title: The Six Trigonometric Ratios: Sine, Cosine, Tangent and Their Reciprocals
learning_goals: Define sine, cosine, and tangent in terms of sides of a right triangle.
Introduce cosecant, secant, and cotangent as reciprocals.
Understand the relationship between the six ratios.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Requires visual representation of a right-angled triangle, labeling sides, and showing ratio formulas. Manim is ideal for animated mathematical definitions.

sections.title: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Tangent
learning_goals: Apply the definitions of trigonometric ratios to find unknown sides.
Calculate all six trigonometric ratios when one ratio is given.
Utilize the Pythagorean theorem in trigonometric calculations.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Step-by-step calculation and application of formulas. Manim can clearly animate the process of finding sides and then ratios.

sections.title: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality
learning_goals: Understand how trigonometric ratios relate to similar triangles.
Prove equality of angles using trigonometric relationships and geometric principles.
Apply the Pythagorean theorem in a proof context.
sections.renderer_reasoning: This involves geometric proofs and relationships between triangles, which Manim can illustrate effectively with diagrams and step-by-step derivations.

sections.title: Verifying Trigonometric Identities: cos²θ + sin²θ
learning_goals: Verify fundamental trigonometric identities.
Relate trigonometric identities to the Pythagorean theorem.
Manipulate trigonometric expressions to prove equality.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Demonstrating algebraic manipulation and geometric interpretation of identities. Manim is suitable for showing the step-by-step verification.

sections.title: Verifying 2sinAcosA = 1 when tanA = 1
learning_goals: Apply trigonometric ratios to verify specific equations.
Practice substituting values derived from one ratio into another expression.
Strengthen understanding of ratio interdependencies.
sections.renderer_reasoning: This is a direct application and verification problem, best shown with animated algebraic steps and triangle diagrams in Manim.

sections.title: Finding sinQ and cosQ from Side Relationships
learning_goals: Solve problems involving trigonometric ratios when side relationships are given.
Formulate and solve systems of equations involving triangle sides.
Calculate specific trigonometric ratios from derived side lengths.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Involves setting up equations based on side relationships and solving for unknown values, which Manim can clearly illustrate.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Recall the definitions of the six trigonometric ratios.
Remember the Pythagorean theorem's role in trigonometry.
Review the reciprocal identities.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review of key concepts and formulas. No complex animations needed.

sections.title: Trigonometry in Action: A Quick Review
learning_goals: Summarize the main concepts of trigonometric ratios.
Reinforce the practical application of these ratios.
